title: Twice a Fool
text: OKay, so in April I got the box from 2016 that a few others got. I cancelled for May, but decided to give it another try for June. Apparently, I'm a sucker. It was missing the tanning item like a couple other people were complaining about and got two hair sprays. I looked on the Allure website, and it wasn't even the box for June! Totally unsubscribing. You get two chances. One can be a fluke, two are bad business. If you don't have enough of the items, put a limit on the number of boxes or get more of the item. Sephora's Play! is so far better and cheaper. Hope that one works out.
label: negative
